name: Any BIC Dec 2014 Identifier
definition: Code allocated to a financial or non-financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority, as described in ISO 9362: 2014 - "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".
format: Not a valid BIC (8 or 11 characters). Expected: 4 uppercase letters or digits, then 2 uppercase letters, then 2 uppercase letters or digits, then optionally 3 uppercase letters or digits. Example: DEUTDEFF / DEUTDEFF500

AnyBIC.definition: Only a valid Business identifier code is allowed. Business identifier codes for financial or non-financial institutions are registered and published by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority in the ISO directory of BICs, and consists of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.
